_note: Watchlist config. cg = CoinGecko id (crypto, fetched live in browser); type stock = nightly quote via workflow. held = you hold it. rank/score/comment = Damian's top-15 conviction ranking (tdr = TDR Pro's own rank); auto:true = Claude's fill-in ranking for names outside the top-15 sheet. Fix any wrong cg id here and redeploy.

rows.name: Bitcoin
rows.comment: Biggest upgrade vs TDR: in a fragile recovery with negative YTD ETF flows, the best risk-adjusted asset should not sit behind seven higher-beta alts.

rows.name: Ethereum
rows.comment: TVL, institutional and stablecoin leadership at a depressed price. Treated as tied with SOL.

rows.name: Coinbase
rows.comment: Agree with TDR.

rows.name: Circle
rows.comment: USDC liquidity + CCTP moat, down 65-75%; OpenUSD is real competition but the moat is underappreciated.

rows.name: Lighter
rows.comment: First name outside your 15: buybacks + Ethereum anchoring + Robinhood ties, but price has outrun fundamentals — conviction yes, adds only at ladder zones.

rows.name: Pump.fun
rows.comment: ~$1M/day revenue with 50% recycled into buybacks in a full risk-off bear — the fast-DeFi thesis intact.

rows.name: Ethena
rows.comment: The comeback-story candidate: Coinbase + BlackRock Aladdin distribution, down ~93%, buyback cushion. Needs risk-on to work.

rows.name: SPX6900
rows.comment: Meme tier, but holder-conviction metrics reportedly track Bitcoin's — the strongest cult on the list.

rows.name: The Black Bull
rows.comment: Position closed Aug 1 at +7.4%.

rows.name: Aave
rows.comment: Automated buybacks live since Jun 27; ~$400M annualized fees vs ~$1.5B mcap. Fee softness (-25% from peak) and the $50M-to-$30M buyback cut keep the score below TDR's 9.0.

rows.name: Aerodrome
rows.comment: Base's flagship DEX with real fee share — quality mid-cap, Coinbase-ecosystem beta.

rows.name: BNB
rows.comment: Agree with TDR.

rows.name: Canton
rows.comment: Institutional-chain story is real but token value capture remains opaque.

rows.name: Fluid
rows.comment: Best small-cap fundamentals on the list.

rows.name: Alphabet
rows.comment: Best quality-at-a-reasonable-price equity on the list; defensive in a fragile tape.

rows.name: Robinhood
rows.comment: Crypto financial services + Robinhood Chain = RWA distribution winner regardless of which token captures the value.

rows.name: Hyperliquid
rows.comment: $840M+ annualized fees, 97-99% recycled into buybacks, CFTC clarity. Trimmed for ~23% float and ~$62B FDV.

rows.name: Jito
rows.comment: Solana MEV/staking infrastructure with real fees — the picks-and-shovels of the activity leader.

rows.name: Jupiter
rows.comment: Agree, slightly trimmed for concentrated Solana beta.

rows.name: Morpho
rows.comment: Slow DeFi done right — lending fundamentals growing through the bear; you exited at a profit but the business kept executing.

rows.name: Nvidia
rows.comment: Exceptional business; valuation caps upside.

rows.name: Eightco (WLD DAT)
rows.comment: Leveraged WLD treasury vehicle — an option on Worldcoin, not a business.

rows.name: Pendle
rows.comment: Cheap, productive, real fee base.

rows.name: Raydium
rows.comment: Demoted from TDR's #6: an acknowledged security risk is inconsistent with a top-6 slot.

rows.name: Solana
rows.comment: Activity leader (~4x ETH's daily active addresses; #1 DEX volume). Tied with ETH within the noise band.

rows.name: Sui
rows.comment: Quality L1 at a deep discount; strong tech, weak token-capture story.

rows.name: Maple/Syrup
rows.comment: On-chain credit with real revenue — the RWA theme expressed through an actual lending book.

rows.name: Uniswap
rows.comment: Agree; capture improving but not yet proven.

rows.name: XRP
rows.comment: Deep liquidity and institutional rails, thin fee capture relative to cap.

rows.name: Zcash
rows.comment: Privacy narrative held up unusually well through this bear (Nadeau likes it, doesn't hold it).

rows.name: Bittensor
rows.comment: The decentralized-compute leader — the sector Nadeau says he's researching next; inference bottleneck is the thesis.

rows.name: Aethir
rows.comment: GPU DePIN with real enterprise deals but heavy unlock schedule — deep-dive verdict stands.

rows.name: Venice
rows.comment: Clean burn structure; small-cap risk. (Equity-raise governance wobble is the watch item.)

rows.name: Worldcoin
rows.comment: Identity moonshot with Eightco DAT bid behind it; unlock overhang is the drag.
